checks.name: Backend verify incl. StaffAccessIntegrationTest and Keycloak revoked-token test
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity

scenarios.observed: StaffAccessIntegrationTest.kitchen_scope_matrix: a kitchen-owned resource of cook A is readable by cook A; cook B, a customer and staff without cook.review get 404 with no data; staff with cook.review get 200 and an ALLOWED audit event; cook.review does not confer staff.grant. ContactIntegrationTest (MB-010) covers cross-customer addresses and challenges. Real kitchen/order/case resources apply the same AccessPolicy as they are built (MB-012 onward) and will be re-tested there.

A customer granting themselves staff.grant gets 403 FORBIDDEN, no grant row, and a DENIED audit event; a role field in a customer request is rejected (400); an admin without recent MFA gets 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED (audited); after revocation the same identity's next request (MockMvc) and the same unexpired Keycloak JWT (IdentityIntegrationTest) get 403 with a DENIED audit event; self-escalation and last-admin revocation are refused and audited (a mutation removing noRollbackFor made the audit assertion fail).

Deny-by-default AccessPolicy, server-side grants with expiry/revocation, step-up for grant changes, last-admin protection, expired grants conferring nothing, append-only audit (UPDATE/DELETE rejected by trigger) and redaction (phone and email removed from stored reason; token/code keys masked) all verified on PostgreSQL; audit read API returns redacted entries.

findings: Self-review defect fixed before tests: denial audits inside transactional grant/revoke would be rolled back with the thrown exception; noRollbackFor added (no other writes precede the denial) and proven by mutation.
Replaced a string coupling to the app's request-ID attribute with a shared constant.

Residual: kitchen/order/case scope exercised through a test resource only until those modules exist; audit CSV export (API-095) not implemented; separation of duties for a solo pilot not enforced beyond self-escalation refusal (documented in permissions doc).
Residual: grant changes require MFA assurance from the provider; local Keycloak has no MFA flow configured yet, so step-up success is covered by unit test and synthetic claims, not a real OTP login.
